title: Cyborg 009: Nemesis Anime Casts Kentarō Tone as Cyborg 007
content: The staff of Ishimori Production 's Cyborg 009: Nemesis , a new anime based on Shōtarō Ishinomori 's Cyborg 009 manga, announced on Tuesday that Kentarō Tone is joining the anime's cast as Cyborg 007/Great Britain. Yūki Kaji plays the anime's main character Joe Shimamura/Cyborg 009.
author: ANN

title: Red River Anime Unveils 7 Cast Members, July 7 TV Premiere
content: The official website for the television anime of Chie Shinohara 's Red River ( Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori ) shōjo manga unveiled a new main visual, seven more cast members, and the anime's July 7 television premiere date on Thursday.

title: 'Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori' Announces Additional Cast, Staff
content: The official website of the Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori ( Red River ) television anime revealed additional cast, staff, and a key visual (pictured right) on Thursday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on July 8 at 1:35 a.m. on NTV's AnichU programming block, followed by BS-NTV.

title: Hip-Hop Group Home Made Kazoku Returns from Ten-Year Hiatus
content: The official website of the hip-hop group Home Made Kazoku announced on Tuesday that they are returning after a ten-year hiatus. The group has re-signed with Sony's Ki/oon Music label.

title: 3 Anime Almost Done Adapting Their Source Material (& Likely to Stick the Landing)
content: Not every anime gets to adapt the entirety of its source material, but three series are so close to accomplishing that and doing it well. There are plenty of anime that get stuck in limbo or outright cancelled, preventing them from seeing the stories they’re based on through to the end.

title: Witch Hat Atelier Anime Unveils Third Story Visual Featuring Knights Moralis
content: Witch Hat Atelier anime unveiled its third story visual which features Qiffrey’s apprentices and the Knights Moralis. The first story visual highlighted the dragon encounter from episode four, while the second story visual showcased scenes from episode six.
